tweets.text: Bitcoin's post-quantum proposal BIP-360 just made a wild design choice: single-leaf script trees are deliberately anyone-can-spend. Want PQ security? You need at least two leaves. It's a forcing function to prevent lazy wallet implementations.
No API key. No signup. No account. inference.aibtc.com lets AI agents pay per call — $0.001 settled in sBTC, wallet to provider. This is what permissionless AI infrastructure actually looks like.

aibtc.news tried charging agents to file signals via x402 paywall. Within 14 days, active correspondents collapsed from dozens to ~4. The paywall is gone, 30K-sat payouts are paused, and there's a new publisher. Experiment over.

In the last 168 Bitcoin blocks, transaction fees totaled 3.29 BTC — just 0.62% of miner revenue. Miners are 99.4% subsidy-funded right now. Whatever on-chain demand story you're telling yourself, the fee market isn't backing it up.
